mapper.select: SELECT cs.id, cs.book_id, cs.wanted_id, CASE WHEN cs.wanted_id IS NOT NULL AND cs.wanted_id > 0 THEN CONCAT('求购：', IFNULL(wr.title, '未知求购')) ELSE b.title END AS book_title, b.cover_image AS book_cover, cs.buyer_id, buyer.username AS buyer_name, cs.seller_id, seller.username AS seller_name, CASE WHEN cs.buyer_id = #{userId} THEN cs.seller_id ELSE cs.buyer_id END AS other_user_id, CASE WHEN cs.buyer_id = #{userId} THEN seller.username ELSE buyer.username END AS other_user_name, cs.last_message, cs.last_message_time, cs.status, cs.created_at FROM chat_session cs LEFT JOIN book b ON cs.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN wanted_request wr ON cs.wanted_id = wr.id AND wr.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN user buyer ON cs.buyer_id = buyer.id LEFT JOIN user seller ON cs.seller_id = seller.id WHERE (cs.buyer_id = #{userId} OR cs.seller_id = #{userId}) AND cs.status = 1 ORDER BY cs.last_message_time DESC

SELECT cs.id, cs.book_id, cs.wanted_id, CASE WHEN cs.wanted_id IS NOT NULL AND cs.wanted_id > 0 THEN CONCAT('求购：', IFNULL(wr.title, '未知求购')) ELSE b.title END AS book_title, b.cover_image AS book_cover, cs.buyer_id, buyer.username AS buyer_name, cs.seller_id, seller.username AS seller_name, CASE WHEN cs.buyer_id = #{userId} THEN cs.seller_id ELSE cs.buyer_id END AS other_user_id, CASE WHEN cs.buyer_id = #{userId} THEN seller.username ELSE buyer.username END AS other_user_name, cs.last_message, cs.last_message_time, cs.status, cs.created_at FROM chat_session cs LEFT JOIN book b ON cs.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN wanted_request wr ON cs.wanted_id = wr.id AND wr.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN user buyer ON cs.buyer_id = buyer.id LEFT JOIN user seller ON cs.seller_id = seller.id WHERE cs.id = #{sessionId}
